trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies and this one pops. Budget around 200 hours: the list is long rather than hard, with no online trophies, no difficulty trophies and no mission medals. Finish the story, the side stories and the 100% checklist and the Platinum is yours.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission, Gone Fishing. It is the first story mission, so it pops early in Chapter 1 — just play through the opening. Story missions cannot be replayed, so keep a manual save at the start of each chapter.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 1. Story trophies pop as you play; a chapter trophy can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene. Keep a chapter-start save — there is no mission replay. Do Lucia's balcony meditation during this chapter: it counts toward Positive Mental Attitude and is gone once Chapter 1 ends.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2. Same as the other chapter trophies: finish the chapter's missions and it pops, sometimes at the start of Chapter 3. Character switching between Jason and Lucia opens after Breakfast Run in this chapter.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 3. Watch for the time-sensitive Race Against Yago in Yago's street racing strand during this chapter — it feeds Strangers & Freaks, so save before you race it.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 4. The bank-vault robberies for Maximum Withdrawal unlock through an optional mission near the end of this chapter, so keep an eye out for That's Where The Money Is.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission. Keep an untouched manual save from just before it — it is the one mission you most want a second shot at, and there is no replay. Once the credits roll, everything outside the story stays available.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Breakfast Run. It is a Chapter 2 story mission; switching between Jason and Lucia opens right after it, which also opens up the partner trophies.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the mission The Cartel Heist. A story mission — play through it and the trophy pops on completion.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. A story mission — finish it and the trophy pops.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Headliners. A story mission — finish it and the trophy pops.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the mission VCIA Takedown. A story mission at Vice City International Airport — finish it and the trophy pops.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Operation Savage Glory. A story mission — finish it and the trophy pops.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion. The checklist (35 tasks) appears after the story under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, but work you do earlier still counts. The big items: 300 stunts, 200 of 277 vehicles, 70 of 80 Challenges, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations. It is widely called the hardest trophy on the list, so leave it for last.

sources.name: GTA Vice City Hub — GTA 6 Achievements

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunt jumps, under-the-bridge flights, knife flights and base jumps all count. Keep going past 250 — 100% completion needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — all 9 activity types. Sample one of everything the state offers (races, fishing, arcade, bowling, gym, meditation, hunting, drone races, shooting range) and it pops.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 gold medals across the two shooting ranges. Take your time and learn each range's targets; gold is about accuracy, not speed.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location — 14 locations. Win at least one race at each; you do not need to win every race, just one per location.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Street races and any other race type all count as long as each win is at a different race. Yago's street racing strand in Chapter 3 is a good place to start — its Race Against Yago is time-sensitive, so save first.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Take Cal on in a fishing challenge and out-fish him. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so it also feeds Master of None.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any of the four in-game arcade games counts — pick the one you are best at and finish a full game.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Andy's stranger strand stays open after the credits, so there is no rush — but note Andy's strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks, because it has its own trophy.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand stays open after the story; finish his last mission and the trophy pops.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Billy's strand stays open after the credits. Like Andy's, it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Only some optional questlines count — Andy's, Billy's and Tyrone's do not, because they have their own trophies. Check the trophy's progress counter after each strand you finish. Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon): save first, then race.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Randy's strand stays open after the story; finish his last mission and the trophy pops.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand stays open after the credits and does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots. Spots show as purple icons when you are close, and each outdoor spot counts twice if you meditate there with both characters, so bring your partner every time. THE ONE MISSABLE TROPHY: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — after the mission Down to Earth, check the kitchen in the morning and follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house — disappears once Chapter 1 ends. Do it in Chapter 1 and keep a Chapter 1 save until the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret Vogel's hunting questline is Jason-only and sends you after animals through target decks. A clean head or heart shot keeps the carcass pristine.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Collect the cards scattered across Leonida and finish any three full sets.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Use the WAiNK app to scan at 100 different locations. Scanning vehicles with WAiNK also counts toward discovering them for Whip It Good, so scan traffic as you drive.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are listed under Progress, then Challenges, and many complete on their own while you play. 100% completion needs 70 of the 80, so keep going past 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. The easiest way: a bank vault job gives you 4 stars straight away — escape it with your partner and this pops with Maximum Withdrawal. It only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Call your partner, then rob three shops in a row while the police are still chasing you — if the stars fade and you are only in the red heat zone, the chain breaks. It can take about 30 seconds to pop after you leave the third shop, so give it a moment before a fourth.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Scanning a vehicle with the WAiNK app counts as discovering it, so scan traffic as you drive. 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base models.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aim — press L3 and R3 while aiming — then drop five enemies before it ends. Gang guards at an illegal operation make a good target; an assault rifle works well and Adrenaline extends Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off, then fly about 1 km from the airport and it pops. Save first: the police come fast.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Kinda hot in these Rhinos — get into a military tank. Tanks should be parked on the south side of Mile Zero Air Station, on the island at the far southwest of the map. Save first, get in, and drive and fire until it pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. The Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies. Use it on a store's locked back door — kicking the door in sets off the alarm. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe and leave without being seen. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target. If someone spots you, reload rather than push on.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Vaults unlock through That's Where The Money Is, an optional mission near the end of Chapter 4: tail an armored security van to a large bank and get into the vault while the guard has it open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner. 100% completion needs all eight vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Tail or ambush an armored truck, take it and get away — it only pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the search area.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — all 52 areas. Drive, fly and walk the map until every named area is visited; the game tracks them, so check your map for the gaps.

sources.name: Exophase / PSNProfiles — official PS5 list (via Push Square)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang — one from each of the 9 gangs. 100% completion wants all 39 operations, so this pops along the way.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. No source has confirmed the exact trigger yet — the description is the only hint, so head to a bar on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. It may pop while you play normally; the method will be added once it is confirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. No source has confirmed the exact trigger yet — the description points at driving a car through a showroom's glass front. Try a showroom with a fast car and a clear run at the glass. It may pop while you play normally.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. The alley is Kingpin Bowling, an illegal operation you visit in Chapter 2. Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables — the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb — then escape the police. If you leave something behind, the operation comes back later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership with mass appeal. It should pop when Jason and Lucia both reach maximum Strength. Buy a gym membership and train with your partner there — the partner trains alongside you.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse). 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile. Robberies and fights feed it, so it fills up without a separate grind as you play.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm. No source has confirmed the exact trigger yet — the description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. It may pop while you play normally; the method will be added once confirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: What the hell just happened? No source has confirmed the exact trigger yet — the description suggests a strange or secret event out in the world. Keep an eye out for the odd and the unexplained while you explore; it may pop on its own.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. No source has confirmed the exact trigger yet — the description points at knocking someone down with a melee weapon from a moving vehicle. It may pop while you play normally.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked bills come from bank and payday loan jobs; sell them to your contacts to launder them. The $250,000 total is cumulative.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. The total is cumulative across every kind of shop, so it fills up as you buy weapons, clothes, cars and everything else.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties — all 8 garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, which unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver. Together they cost about $160,000. Garages the story gives you do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The Chapter 2 mission Moses opens the app: take a stolen car to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. From Chapter 3 you can also register cars with a standard tracker at Pay 'n' Spray. Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first and register cheap cars.
